title: The Circle's First Ring Chamber

features.name: the first ring
features.desc-on-touch: A tree counting backward into itself. The circle remembers being seeds before it remembered being wood. You hold the earliest year in your hand.

features.name: the concentric memory
features.desc-on-touch: Stack after stack of time, each one reading the stump's own history. The children learned that growing backward was still growth.

features.name: the teaching circle
features.desc-on-touch: Where the stumps showed the archive how to count in rings. The circle has not forgotten what it learned. It teaches the soil now.

features.name: the growing-backward pool
features.desc-on-touch: Water pooling in the stump's hollow. It reflects the sky that watched the tree grow down into itself. Time moves differently here.

inscription: the children showed the stumps that growing backward was still growing; now the circle remembers teaching more than it remembers being trees
